theater: 旁遮普蘇特利傑河谷與拉合爾

battle.name: 第二次英國錫克戰爭
battle.theater: 旁遮普蘇特利傑河谷與拉合爾
battle.brief: 一八四八年六月起，東印度公司要求錫克宮廷交出邊防軍隊，遭拒後開火。英軍自費羅茲普爾沿蘇特利傑河東岸推進，錫克軍退守拉合爾，奇利安瓦拉、阿里瓦爾與巴欣三戰之後，一八四九年三月二十九日以《拉合爾條約》收場。卡面雷管步槍是英軍步兵的制式槍械，底火不受冬晨濃霧影響，正是旁遮普會戰得以在霧中交火的前提。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是英屬印度的東印度公司與錫克帝國，即以卡爾薩軍為骨幹的拉合爾宮廷。英方以孟加拉軍與印度陸軍為主體，兵員集中在費羅茲普爾、勒克瑙與阿托克等旁遮普據點，決策權集中於英王任命的印度總督：一八四八年二月上任的達利豪斯以宗主權的名義接手了前總督哈丁的立場，哈丁則繼續擔任孟加拉總督至同年六月。野戰指揮分三層：戈夫勳爵統率主力沿蘇特利傑河東岸推進，納皮爾中將負責木爾坦方向，哈利·史密斯爵士領第師、撒克韋爾領第一師各走一路；赫伯特·愛德華茲在白沙瓦組織的旁遮普非正規軍、亨利·戴利所部的嚮導團與廓爾喀營承擔山徑側翼與追擊。英方補給線由大幹道、費羅茲普爾至拉合爾的縱隊線，以及蘇特利傑河上的浮橋與駁船群構成。錫克一方則是靠一紙宮廷命令調度的常備軍，分為步兵、騎兵與約百門火炮的托普哈納三部分，名義上隸於馬哈拉賈舍爾·辛格，其母金德考爾攝政至一八四六年，實際調度分交四位師長沙姆辛格·阿托克、阿卡利·普拉辛格、法特赫辛格·卡利安瓦拉與阿吉特辛格·桑德哈瓦利亞，情報則由彌爾斯里萬·昌德掌握。英方承認錫克軍是受過歐洲式訓練的職業軍隊，其線形操典與炮兵技術皆出自文圖拉、休·惠勒等歐洲教官之手；但自一八四四年起歐洲教官被逐步解除職責，軍中英籍與天主教士的成份遭清洗，裝備補充與人事因此在開戰前已經斷裂。
countriesEn: The two sides were the English East India Company in British India and the Sikh Empire, that is the Lahore court whose armed force was the Khalsa Army. The British side was built on the Bengal Army and the Indian Army, with troops concentrated at Ferozepur, Lucknow and Attock, and with decisions centred on the Governor-General appointed from London: Dalhousie, who took office in February 1848, took over his predecessor Hardinge's position under the doctrine of paramountcy, while Hardinge continued as Governor of Bengal until June of the same year. Field command ran in three layers. Lord Gough led the main body up the east bank of the Sutlej; Napier held the Multan direction; Sir Harry Smith led one division and Thackwell another on parallel lines. The Punjab Irregular Force organised by Herbert Edwardes at Peshawar, the Corps of Guides under Henry Daly and the Gurkha battalions covered the flanks in the hills and the pursuit. The British supply line was built on the Grand Trunk Road, the convoy road from Ferozepur to Lahore, and the pontoon bridges and barge groups on the Sutlej. The Sikh side was a standing army moved by orders from the court, divided into infantry, cavalry and a topkhana of roughly a hundred guns. Nominally it belonged to Maharaja Sher Singh, whose mother Jind Kaur had been regent until 1846, but actual command was shared among four generals, Sham Singh of Attock, Akali Phula Singh, Fateh Singh Kalianwala and Ajit Singh Sandhanwalia, while intelligence was in the hands of Misr Diwan Chand. The British accepted that the Sikh army was a professional force trained in European fashion, its linear drill and its artillery technique owing much to European instructors such as Ventura and Hugh Wheeler; but from 1844 on, European instructors were progressively dismissed, British and Catholic elements in the ranks were purged, and resupply and personnel had already broken down before the war began.
people: The decisive figures stood at the two ends of the conflict. On the Sikh side, when Ranjit Singh died at Lahore in June 1839, five-year-old Duleep Singh succeeded and the widowed Rani Jind Kaur took the regency; the court then saw regents, courtiers and the Commander-in-Chief of the Khalsa army fight each other for the substance of power, while the claims of a collateral line headed by Gajjar Singh and the support of the Sandhanwalia clan hollowed out the centre. The Treaty of Amritsar of 1846 sold Kashmir to the British with the price payable in instalments to the Lahore court, and in 1848 the regency was surrendered; each step was read in Lahore as encroachment. The Sikh frontier troops refused to accept British command, rose in the spring of 1848, and were disarmed by the British. When the Lahore court asked for a British envoy accredited to the durbar and was given instead an officer of the East India Company, the refusal was treated as an insult, and mutual trust collapsed. On the British side the main figures were Dalhousie and Hardinge: the first wanted the Punjab question settled once and for all in the name of paramountcy, the second had proposed that the Sikh frontier troops be handed over to British service, and the deadlock over that proposal became the immediate occasion of the war. On the field, Sir Harry Smith lost almost a whole brigade in the frontal attack at Chillianwala, then broke the Sikh rearguard at Aliwal; Napier's column had been besieging Multan since June 1848 and took the city by assault, Napier himself being shot through the shoulder; Gough held the centre; Thackwell took the Lahore treasury at Bhasin. For the Sikhs, Mulla Shah Badakhshi and Wazir Imad-ud-Daula held Multan for months without surrendering, and the Afghan ally Akram Khan shared the defence. Akali Phula Singh and Sham Singh's attack on Attock in December 1848 was the last large offensive the Khalsa army ever made.

kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍恰好落在旁遮普的火器世代轉換點上。英軍印度步兵在本地仍以口徑五十四分之一英吋的布朗·貝斯滑膛燧發槍為主，一八四〇年代起在原槍機上加裝雷管，改成所謂卡達克式，以便在潮濕、塵土與硝煙中仍然擊發；射程更遠的恩菲爾德步槍要到一八五一年式以後才成軍配發，因此不屬於本戰的裝備。英軍的野戰骨幹是六磅與九磅野戰炮，另有孟加拉騎炮兵、火箭旅與駱駝運輸隊，攻城則倚重施放壅塞炮與突擊部隊；嚮導團與旁遮普非正規軍使用滑膛槍、卡賓槍與傑扎伊爾長管槍，在丘陵小徑上作戰。錫克軍的槍械則是雜亂的拼盤：卡爾薩步兵的骨幹是早年繳獲與外購的燧發滑膛槍、火繩槍，一八四〇年代也配了一批雷管改造槍，但各營比例不一；火繩槍在旁遮普的乾燥季節尚可使用，冬季清晨的濃霧裡卻會因火繩受潮而失火率驟降，這正是雷管底火在本地被特別看重的原因。炮兵是錫克軍最精銳的部分：托普哈納由受過歐洲訓練的炮手操縱，保有數門重型攻城炮與大量火箭，拉合爾與科特利洛哈爾一帶的鑄炮廠仍在出炮，野戰中拉車的牛隊與騎兵的馬匹則是錫克方的主要運輸工具。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card falls exactly at the point where the firepower of the Punjab was changing generation. The British Indian infantry still carried the .54 calibre smoothbore Brown Bess in flintlock form, and from the 1840s a percussion cap was fitted to the existing lock to produce the so-called Khadak, which would fire in damp, dust and powder smoke alike; the longer-ranging Enfield rifle was not distributed to troops until after the 1851 pattern and so does not belong to this war. The core of the British artillery was the six- and nine-pounder field gun, with the Bengal Horse Artillery, a rocket brigade and a camel transport train; for siege work the army relied on breaching guns and assault columns. The Corps of Guides and the Punjab Irregular Force used smoothbores, carbines and the long jezail, and fought along the hill tracks. The Sikh musketry was a patchwork: the backbone of the Khalsa infantry was flintlock smoothbores and matchlocks taken in earlier wars or bought in, and a batch of converted percussion muskets was issued in the 1840s, but the proportion varied from battalion to battalion. The matchlock could still be used in the dry season of the Punjab, yet in the winter dawn fog its priming would fail often, which is precisely why the percussion primer was valued so highly here. The artillery was the finest part of the Sikh army: the topkhana was worked by gunners trained in the European fashion, it kept a number of heavy siege pieces and a large quantity of rockets, and the foundries at Lahore and Kotli Lohar were still casting guns; in the field the ox-carts of the baggage train and the horses of the cavalry were the Sikhs' main means of movement.
tactics: 英軍的戰術骨架是一八四〇年代英軍在印度養成的線形野戰：步兵以營為單位排成稀疏橫線，炮兵集中於側翼，騎兵在兩翼待命，攻擊時靠刺刀平推而不是靠齊射。奇利安瓦拉最能暴露這種戰法的弱點：一八四九年一月十三日清晨，英軍在薄霧中分四線縱隊前進，進至距錫克軍不足百碼才下令射擊，兩度被密集的錫克火線頂回，直到右翼迂迴與後續部隊趕到才把陣線撬開，代價是英軍陣亡與負傷逾兩千人。蘇特利傑河上的行動則是純粹的工程課：英軍在斐勒與阿里瓦爾之間架設浮橋，把河東岸的攻勢一點一點壓向西岸，追擊撤退中的錫克軍後隊。巴欣之戰改為拂曉突襲：英軍利用晨霧掩護行軍，接近後以步兵縱隊連續發起衝鋒，攻破錫克軍的營盤並奪得其國庫。木爾坦的圍城則是典型的十九世紀攻城：先以壕溝與胸牆封鎖城門，再用炮火在城牆上打開缺口，最後以密集縱隊突入；英軍在攻城總計傷亡數百人，守軍則因糧盡與疫病在城破之前已大量耗損。錫克軍的戰術以守點與拖延見長：依托堡壘、村寨與要塞構成外層警戒網，一旦英軍逼近即退往下一處據點；一八四八年十二月對阿托克英軍堡壘的夜襲是它最後一次主動進攻，四位師長各率一翼在夜裡包抄，卻因缺乏協同與工兵手段而未能破壞工事，被英軍騎兵反擊逐退。
tacticsEn: The frame of British tactics was the linear war of the 1840s that the army had learned in India: infantry deployed in thin line by battalion, artillery massed on the flanks, cavalry waiting on the wings, and attacks pushed forward on the bayonet rather than delivered by volley. Chillianwala exposed the weakness of that method better than any other action. On the morning of 13 January 1849 the British advanced in four lines of columns through the mist, did not order fire until they were within a hundred yards, and were twice thrown back by the dense Sikh fire line; the front was only levered open when the right wing turned it and reinforcements came up, at a cost of more than two thousand British dead and wounded. The movement on the Sutlej was pure engineering: the British bridged the river between Phillaur and Aliwal and pressed the attack on the east bank westward step by step, catching the Sikh rearguard as it withdrew. Bhasin was fought as a dawn assault: the British used the morning mist to mask their march, and once in contact drove forward with successive infantry columns, breaking the Sikh camp and taking its treasury. The siege of Multan was a typical nineteenth-century siege: trenches and breastworks first to seal the gates, then guns to open a breach in the wall, and finally dense columns through the gap; British casualties in the assault ran to several hundred, while the garrison had already been worn down by want of food and by disease before the city fell. The Sikh way of war favoured holding ground and wearing the attacker out: a ring of forts, villages and strongpoints formed the outer screen, and when the British closed in the force simply fell back to the next position. The night attack on the British garrison at Attock in December 1848 was their last deliberate offensive, the four generals leading wings in a night envelopment, but without coordination or engineering they could not breach the works and were driven off by the British cavalry.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：戰爭自一八四八年六月木爾坦的英方官員遇襲起，至一八四九年三月二十九日《拉合爾條約》簽訂，歷時約九個月。錫克軍的常備兵力一般估計在十二萬上下，其中步兵約五萬至七萬、騎兵約一萬五千至二萬、炮兵約一百門上下，分駐拉合爾、木爾坦與西北邊境；英軍在旁遮普的野戰兵力遠小於此，戈夫的主力與各師合計約一萬五千至二萬人，另有旁遮普非正規軍與嚮導團承擔側翼任務。最慘烈的一場是奇利安瓦拉（一八四九年一月十三日），英軍陣亡與負傷合計約兩千人（一說陣亡二百餘、負傷一千六百餘），是英國在印度歷史上損失最重的單日會戰之一。巴欣之戰（一八四九年二月二十二日）英軍傷亡數百人，錫克軍被俘者約八千人，其餘大部潰散於平原。木爾坦於一八四九年一月二十二日城破，英軍奪得的錫克國庫現金約合英鎊四十萬上下。領地方面，錫克帝國在拉合爾的統治至此終結，旁遮普全境併入英屬印度，新取得的邊境自此由英方 garrison 與整套稅收、運河工程體系接管。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war ran from the killing of the British officials at Multan in June 1848 to the signature of the Treaty of Lahore on 29 March 1849, about nine months in all. The standing strength of the Sikh army is generally put at something like 120,000 men, of whom perhaps fifty to seventy thousand were infantry, fifteen to twenty thousand cavalry, and the gunners of about a hundred pieces, distributed between Lahore, Multan and the north-western frontier. The British field force in the Punjab was far smaller: Gough's main body and the divisions together came to roughly fifteen to twenty thousand men, with the Punjab Irregular Force and the Guides taking the flanks. The bloodiest action was Chillianwala on 13 January 1849, where British dead and wounded together came to about two thousand, one account giving 247 killed and 1,637 wounded, and it ranks among the heaviest single-day losses the British army ever suffered in India. At Bhasin on 22 February 1849 the British lost several hundred men, while about eight thousand Sikhs were taken prisoner and the rest broke up over the plain. Multan fell on 22 January 1849, and the cash taken from the Sikh treasury there was worth roughly £400,000. In terms of territory, Sikh rule at Lahore ended here and the whole of the Punjab was incorporated into British India, and the newly acquired frontier passed to British garrisons and to a complete apparatus of revenue and canal works.
cause: 起因是多層的。第一層是王位繼承：一八三九年蘭吉特·辛格病逝，五歲的達利普·辛格繼位，寡母金德考爾攝政，宮廷內既有權臣爭衡，也有旁支王族與禁軍挑戰攝政，錫克帝國的中央權力在開戰前已經空心化。第二層是英國的邊疆政策：一八四六年《阿姆利則條約》取得喀什米爾，並以分期付款的形式把債務轉給錫克宮廷；一八四七年起英方以駐軍、未付清款項與宗主權的名義步步逼近；拉合爾宮廷要求英國派遣正式外交代表常駐而被拒，改派東印度公司職員更被視為屈辱，雙方的互信由此崩解。第三層是軍隊的爭奪：英方以邊境安全為由要求錫克宮廷交出由印度教徒與穆斯林組成的邊防步兵，宮廷斷然拒絕，僵局在長老會議上拖過數月。第四層是直接導火線：一八四八年四月，拉合爾宮廷的邊防部隊在阿托克一帶起事反對英方接管，被英方解除了武裝；同年六月十八日，木爾坦的英方駐地官員被當地迪萬所部殺害，圍城自此開始；卡蘇爾一帶英人遇害的事件亦被英方用作要求錫克方面懲罰兇手的理由，而宮廷拒絕。此時達利豪斯剛於二月接任印度總督，主張以宗主權的名義一次解決旁遮普問題，戰爭於是從權力競逐變成武裝對決。
causeEn: The causes ran in several layers. The first was the succession. When Ranjit Singh died in 1839, five-year-old Duleep Singh inherited and the widowed Jind Kaur became regent; within the court ministers fought for power, a collateral princely line and the Commander-in-Chief of the army challenged the regency, and the central authority of the Sikh state had been hollowed out before a shot was fired. The second was British frontier policy. The Treaty of Amritsar of 1846 took Kashmir and transferred the debt for it to the Lahore court as instalments; from 1847 the British advanced step by step in the name of garrisons, unpaid instalments and paramountcy. When the Lahore court asked for a British envoy accredited to the durbar and was refused, being offered instead an officer of the East India Company, the answer was taken as an insult and trust collapsed on both sides. The third was the contest over troops. The British demanded that the court hand over the frontier infantry of its army, in which Hindus and Muslims served, on the ground of frontier security; the court refused flatly and the deadlock dragged through the elders' council for months. The fourth was the immediate occasion. In April 1848 the frontier troops of the Lahore court rose in the districts around Attock against being taken over by the British and were disarmed; on 18 June of the same year the British officials at Multan were killed by the troops of the local diwan, and the siege began. The killing of British men at Kasur was likewise used by the British as ground for demanding that the offenders be punished, and the court refused. Dalhousie had taken office as Governor-General in February, and wanted the Punjab question settled once and for all in the name of paramountcy; the war therefore changed from a contest of influence into an armed one.
impact: 影響涵蓋軍事、行政與政治三層。軍事上，錫克軍的解散是印度式僱傭軍時代的終點：其步兵、騎兵與炮兵骨幹被分別編入孟加拉軍與旁遮普非正規軍，桑德哈瓦利亞、卡利安瓦拉等家族的要職被逐一拔除，錫克騎兵成為英軍旁遮普騎兵的骨幹，錫克炮手則把歐洲式的炮兵紀律帶進印度炮兵隊；英方同時承認錫克軍的訓練水準，並據此改組了孟加拉陸軍的線形射擊與刺刀教練。行政上，一八四九年設立的拉合爾委員會延續錫克時期的固定地稅與運河灌溉辦法，十九世紀六十年代起興建的運河殖民地把旁遮普的耕地與水利重新規劃，今日印巴邊境的分歧線正是這套土地測量與水利投資的產物之一。政治上，英國以宗主權把旁遮普納入印度，此後不久即以同一邏輯兼併阿瓦德，直接引爆一八五七年的起義，而起義中最頑強的守軍正是被英方收編的錫克兵與旁遮普非正規軍，雙方在德里山脊上以同一支軍隊的兩種身分交鋒。錫克政治則失去作為獨立國家的地位：一八五〇年達利普·辛格以科伊努爾鑽石換取年金，錫克教團體在英方監督下重建，一八七三年成立的辛格 Sabha 與後來的反對運動都源於此一記憶。
impactEn: The consequences ran across three levels, military, administrative and political. Militarily, the dissolution of the Sikh army closed the era of the Indian style of hired armies: its infantry, cavalry and gunners were absorbed into the Bengal Army and the Punjab Irregular Force, the key commands held by families such as the Sandhanwalias and the Kalianwalas were taken away one by one, Sikh horsemen became the backbone of the British Punjab cavalry, and Sikh gunners carried European-style artillery discipline into the Indian artillery. At the same time the British acknowledged the standard of the Sikh army's training and reorganised the Bengal Army's linear fire drill and bayonet instruction accordingly. Administratively, the Board of Revenue established at Lahore in 1849 carried on the fixed land assessment and the canal irrigation of Sikh times, and the canal colonies built from the 1860s onward replanned the cultivation and the water supply of the province; the line that today divides India and Pakistan is in part a product of that land settlement and hydraulic investment. Politically, the British brought the Punjab into India in the name of paramountcy, and within a few years annexed Awadh by exactly the same logic, which led directly to the rising of 1857; and among the most stubborn defenders in that rising were the Sikh soldiers and the Punjab Irregular Force whom the British had enlisted, so that the two sides met on the Delhi Ridge as two identities of the same force. Politically the Sikhs lost the standing of an independent state: in 1850 Duleep Singh surrendered the Koh-i-Noor in return for an annuity, the Khalsa institutions were rebuilt under British supervision, and the Singh Sabha founded in 1873 and the later political agitation both grew out of that memory.
result: 結果是錫克帝國的覆滅與旁遮普的併入。一八四九年二月二十二日巴欣之戰後，錫克軍放棄蘇特利傑河東岸，全軍退向拉合爾；英軍不戰而取拉合爾，並在城中的達利普·辛格宮廷裡掌握了錫克國庫、鑄幣廠與軍械庫。三月二十九日《拉合爾條約》簽訂：英國正式兼併旁遮普，錫克軍解散，宮廷的印璽與王權移交英方；年僅九歲的馬哈拉賈達利普·辛格被保留為名義上的君主，其母金德考爾被安置在貝拿勒斯並受英方看管，宮廷大臣被遣散或降級。錫克軍建制隨即被拆散重組：部分團改編為旁遮普步兵與騎兵團，炮兵與嚮導連同其歐洲式操典併入印度軍械體系，這套血統與裝備的組合在一八五七年成為英軍可用之資源。代價是雙方面的：英軍在會戰中傷亡數千人，錫克軍損失慘重，被俘與失散者合計以萬計，其常備軍作為獨立武裝力量就此不復存在。這場戰爭同時把英國的印度東北邊界推到印度河與阿托克一線，而這條邊界在二十餘年後仍須承受遠征軍的考驗：一八七八年的第二次英阿戰爭與喀布爾遠征，其前提正是這次兼併。
resultEn: The result was the extinction of the Sikh state and the incorporation of the Punjab. After the battle of Bhasin on 22 February 1849 the Sikh army gave up the east bank of the Sutlej and withdrew towards Lahore; the British entered Lahore without a battle, and in the palace of Duleep Singh they took possession of the Sikh treasury, the mint and the arsenal. The Treaty of Lahore was signed on 29 March: the Punjab was formally annexed, the Sikh army was disbanded, and the seals and sovereignty of the court passed to the British. Nine-year-old Maharaja Duleep Singh was kept as a nominal monarch, his mother Jind Kaur was placed at Benares under British watch, and the ministers of the court were dispersed or demoted. The military structure of the Sikhs was then taken apart and reconstituted: some regiments were renumbered as Punjab infantry and cavalry, and the artillery and the guides, with their European-style drill, were folded into the Indian military establishment, a mixture of blood and equipment that in 1857 became a resource the British could use. The cost fell on both sides. The British counted several thousand dead and wounded in the battles, the Sikh losses were heavy, and their prisoners and scattered men together ran into the tens of thousands, so that the standing army ceased to exist as an independent armed force. The war at the same time pushed Britain's north-eastern frontier of India back to the Indus and to Attock, and that frontier had still to bear the weight of expeditionary armies more than twenty years later: the Second Anglo-Afghan War of 1878 and the march on Kabul both presupposed this annexation.
